claim: The native campaign soak has a fail-closed resumable runner, and the rejected first attempt is classified as a Steam/bootstrap failure rather than 31 campaign-map failures.

properties: Refuses to run when Doom3 is already active.
Steam mode refuses to launch while another executable below steamapps/common is active unless explicitly overridden.
Distinguishes launcher_failure, bootstrap_failure, load_failure, load_timeout, runtime_crash, runtime_log_failure and passed.
Aborts the batch after launcher_failure or bootstrap_failure.
Supports StartIndex, EndIndex and identity-checked Resume.
Writes the report atomically after every attempted map and hashes the plan, executable and qconsole log.

native_acceptance.blocked_by: Another Steam game was active; no user process was stopped or interrupted.
native_acceptance.next_gate: Run the v2 Steam batch when Steam is free and require 61 passed, log-hashed rows.

limits: A runner smoke test does not establish that Doom can start through Steam.
The rejected v1 rows contain no map verdict because the engine never initialized far enough to create qconsole.log.
Static closure and a clean 60-second idle do not replace solo progression, two-peer co-op or matched original-Xbox fidelity testing.
